Currencies.Name: Currencies
Currencies.Label: Configure currencies
Currencies.Hint: Monetary systems, coins, exchange rates, money changer fee and link with the game system's sheet.

Wallet.Title: Purse
Wallet.ExchangeHint: The money changer keeps a {fee}% fee.
Wallet.ExchangeAll: Leave the amount empty to exchange everything.

Shop.Title: Shops
Shop.SellHint: The merchant buys back at {ratio}% of their price.

Editor.Title: Shop — {name}
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.MarkupHint: Markup (or discount if negative) applied to every price in the shop.
Editor.SellRatioHint: Share of the price the merchant pays when a player sells them an item.
Editor.ElasticityHint: Strength of supply and demand: 0.5 = the price rises 50% when stock is empty, and drops when stock is above normal.
Editor.FactorsHint: The price stays between these two multiples of the base price.
Editor.RestockHint: How often (world time, in hours) stock returns toward normal. 0 = manual restock.
Editor.TreasuryHint: Merchant's money to buy items back. Empty = unlimited.
Editor.DropHint: Drop an item here to add it.
Editor.Linked: Linked to an item: the buyer receives it (click to unlink)
Editor.TargetHint: Normal stock: below it the price rises, above it the price drops.
Editor.RestockAmountHint: Units returning (or selling off) toward normal each interval.
Editor.BuybackHint: The merchant buys this item back.

Ledger.Title: Loans and debts
Ledger.ConfirmForgive: Forgive this debt? The debtor will owe nothing more.
Ledger.ConfirmCancel: Cancel this debt? No money is returned.
Ledger.TransferHint: Loan: the creditor pays the sum to the debtor as soon as the debt is accepted. Unchecked: a simple IOU.

Currencies.Title: Currencies
Currencies.FeeHint: Percentage kept by the money changer when exchanging between monetary systems.
Currencies.SheetPathHint: Where linked coins are read on actor sheets. "auto" = system.currency for dnd5e, nothing for other systems. Empty: everything is stored by Mint.
Currencies.RateHint: Value of this system's smallest unit compared to other systems. E.g. 1 for the kingdom, 0.8 for a slightly weaker foreign currency.
Currencies.PrimaryHint: Used when an amount is typed without a unit, and to guess prices.
Currencies.Name: Name
Currencies.ValueHint: Value in the system's smallest units (the smallest coin is worth 1).
Currencies.SheetKeyHint: Sheet field to keep in sync (e.g. gp for dnd5e). Empty = stored by Mint.
Currencies.LastCurrency: A system keeps at least one coin.
Currencies.ConfirmRemoveSystem: Remove the {name} system and its coins? Those coins will no longer be shown.
Currencies.SmallestWarn: This system's smallest coin should be worth 1, otherwise change cannot always be given exactly.
Currencies.ConfirmPreset: Replace the whole currency configuration with this preset?

Notify.Proposal: {from} proposes a debt of {amount}: open Loans and debts to answer.

Error.NoGM: No GM connected: this action needs a GM.
